label: fig:method
text: Overall methodology. The three distributed files are traced to their published sources and audited, cleaning produces Benchmark_clean, and every model is then scored under three evaluation regimes that progressively remove training-test overlap. Hatching distinguishes the audit steps (dotted) from the evaluation regimes (diagonal); dashed outlines mark the modelling steps.

label: fig:lineage
text: Provenance of the three files and the origin of the overlap. A: inside each resource the training and test sets share no sequence. B: the distributed training file combines the AIPpred benchmark with 612 AntiInflam training sequences, so each resource's test set meets the other's training data, and 211 of the 425 sequences of Ind_425 and 298 of the 1,049 of Ind_1049 occur in the training file. Source: results/tables/T3.5_cross_benchmark_leakage.csv.

label: tab:overlap
text: Exact overlap between each training set and each independent set, by direction, with the number of independent-set sequences at identity 0.9 or more to the training set. Percentages are of the independent set. Source: results/tables/T3.5_cross_benchmark_leakage.csv.

label: tab:regimes
text: Size and class composition of the three evaluation regimes for each independent set. Source: results/v2/regime_composition.csv.

label: fig:regimes
text: The three evaluation regimes. Bar length is the number of test sequences surviving each regime, distinguished by hatching; the counts are those of Table 3.2. Only the test sets change; the training collection is the same in all three.

label: fig:aipnet
text: The network used for the mean-pooled reference model B1. The frozen ESM-2 encoder serves as a feature extractor only; one shared encoder feeds two heads, so the cross-entropy gradient (solid) and the contrastive gradient (dashed) update the same representation, the weight λ setting how much the contrastive term contributes.

label: fig:splits
text: Cross-validation and splitting protocol. Each of the five folds is held out in turn (cross-hatched); the scaler and the positive-class weight are fitted on the training part only and applied to the held-out part, so no information from the held-out peptides reaches the model. The folds are redrawn for each of five seeds, giving 25 runs per configuration. Final models (dashed) are trained on all of Benchmark_clean with a stratified 10 per cent hold-out for early stopping.
